008package paint.shared.constants;
009
010/**
011 * Defines timing-related constants and playback settings for the PAINT application.
012 * <p>
013 * The {@code PaintTiming} class centralizes constants related to frame intervals, acquisition
014 * rates, and UI animation/playback timings.
015 * </p>
016 */
017public final class PaintTiming {
018
019    private PaintTiming() {
020        // Prevent instantiation
021    }
022
023    /** Default time interval between frames in seconds. */
024    public static final double TIME_INTERVAL      = 0.05;
025    /** Default number of frames per recording. */
026    public static final double FRAMES             = 2000;
027    /** Default total duration of a recording in seconds. */
028    public static final double RECORDING_DURATION = FRAMES * TIME_INTERVAL;
029    // TODO These should be JSON parameters
030}
